# 動畫方塊

現在挖掘和放置方塊時都會有動畫效果！

| 挖掘動畫 | 放置動畫（僅限 2.0.0+） |
|---|---|
| ![Mining Animation](https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExODA1enl6dXllaXhzc2NiNDF6YjcycTJma3Q4OHpjZmRsM3V5a2IxcSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/pMn2D4FnyJlPTlbeUz/giphy.gif) | ![Placing Animation](https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZTZhajF1bzZhMG5udzdwdHRhYndnemlveWF6YnZ5NnFxODM2aXJvdyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/fqCrxodEBlL8SPEhtA/giphy.gif) |

## 自訂

這些動畫可以透過資源包完全自訂。

<details>
<summary>範例</summary>

![Resource Pack Tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67d15ceae8f70e1409a5bc334d81ae1fbef93a9d.png)

**animations_config.json**:
```json
{
  "global": {                 // 所有方塊預設皆會套用此動畫
    "mining_animation": "mining_and_placing_animations:animations/global_mining_animation",
    "placing_animation": "mining_and_placing_animations:animations/global_placing_animation"
  },
  "specific": [               // 您可為特定方塊設定專屬動畫
    {
      "blocks": [
        "minecraft:dirt",
        "minecraft:stone",
        "#minecraft:slabs"    // 可使用標籤
      ],
      "mining_animation": "mining_and_placing_animations:animations/dirt_mining_animation",
      "placing_animation": "mining_and_placing_animations:animations/dirt_placing_animation"
    },
    {
      "blocks": [
        "minecraft:cobblestone"
      ],
      "mining_animation": "mining_and_placing_animations:animations/cobblestone"  // 若未提供 'placing_animation'，將套用全域放置動畫，挖掘動畫亦同
    }
  ],
  "mining_blacklist": [
    "#minecraft:beds",        // 可使用標籤
    "#minecraft:doors",
    "minecraft:oak_planks",
  ],
  "placing_blacklist": [
    "#minecraft:pressure_plates",
    "minecraft:rail",
    "minecraft:snow_block"
  ]
}
```

動畫檔案必須存放在 'animations' 資料夾內。

**dirt_mining_animation.json**（可能的挖掘動畫範例，放置動畫同理）：
```json
{
  "duration": 0.15,           // 動畫長度（秒）
  "pivot_point": [0.5, 1.0, 0.5],
  "keyframes": [
    {
      "time": 0.0,
      "translation": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
      "rotation": [-22.5, 0.0, 45.0],
      "scale": [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]
    },
    {
      "time": 0.05,
      "translation": [20.0, 0.0, -20.0],
      "rotation": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
      "scale": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
    },
    {
      "time": 0.10,
      "translation": [0.0, -15.0, 0.0],
      "rotation": [0.0, -90.0, 0.0],
      "scale": [1.5, 1.5, 1.5]
    },
    {
      "time": 0.15,
      "translation": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
      "rotation": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
      "scale": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
    }
  ]
}
```

您可以建立任意數量的動畫！
</details>
